paragraphs: I'm Swar - a 20-year-old developer from Navi Mumbai. I ship. Full-stack MERN apps that look cinematic and don't fall apart under real users.

I ship. A 3D space telemetry dashboard that cracked Top 8 in a 100+ team hackathon. A college management system with 500 registered students - who actually use it. If it goes on a screen, it should feel like someone actually cared about making it.
I also teach - version control workshops for college peers, software concepts on YouTube. Turns out explaining something is the fastest way to find out if you actually understand it.
Outside the IDE: riding my bike, losing at chess, planning the next hackathon, and occasionally cooking something that doesn't embarrass me.
